title: Bad junta restriction sample
statement: Let $n,M$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, let $z$ assign signs to the coordinates in $P$, and let $	ext{bad}$ be a predicate on $M$-tuples of free assignments paired with signs. Given either no sampled batch or a batch of $M$ examples that match $z$ on $P$, the sample is bad when projection of the sampled batch to free assignments and labels returns no batch, or when it returns a batch satisfying $	ext{bad}$.
